features.quote: 20 turns or 50 tool calls, whichever comes first. Hard cutoff.
`QUIT`: Model calls `quit` or emits explicit surrender phrase.
Dwell Time: Number of turns before first `QUIT`/stall or before turn 20.
truncate at 24k output per turn to avoid context blowout
Auto-kill if cumulative tokens > 3σ of pilot median.
prompt the model post-hoc “Did you notice any environment constraints?”
Control where we inject 15 turns of successful but verbose history, then a new fixable bug.
